expectedIssues: The word Restaurants is misspelled Restarants
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge with its title truncated mid-word. While this signals scrollability, there is no explicit scroll indicator or peek padding to make the affordance obvious.
The search placeholder text reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' which appears to be a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.

The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is also cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, which is acceptable for a scrollable row but lacks a visual cue that more categories exist.
